name: Fractalicons
description: Tree-shakeable Svelte 5 icon library consolidating 35,000+ static, Web Animations API animated, and shape-morphing icons across 34 families with short-prefix imports.

name: Fractalstyler
description: Zero-stylesheet CSS and SASS composition styling system for Svelte and web apps where a strict semantic class registry and design tokens serve as the public API.

name: Fractalsvelte UI
description: Token-driven Svelte 5 Runes component library for SvelteKit featuring 91+ accessible UI components, layouts, and motion primitives with scoped CSS and zero Tailwind dependencies.

name: Svutils
description: Zero-dependency, SSR-safe Svelte 5 Runes utility library providing reactive primitives for reduced motion, intervals, view transitions, clipboard, localStorage persistence, theme mode, and responsive breakpoints.

name: GPUI Svelte
description: GPU-accelerated native desktop UI runtime and compiler for Svelte 5 built on Zed's Rust GPUI engine with 86+ typed native components in a standalone N-API package.

name: Rta UI
description: Svelte 5 and SvelteKit base component library and interactive design studio powered by Fractalstyler tokens with self-contained scoped styles and zero Tailwind dependencies.

name: Kinetics
description: Interactive motion gallery of 153 spring-physics micro-interactions for web interfaces with live physics parameter readouts and copy-paste CSS and Svelte 5 code.

name: Machines UI
description: Monospace ASCII and character-drawn Svelte 5 component library featuring terminal animations, data graphs, technical diagrams, and a node-and-edge workflow builder.

name: Monocode
description: Bidirectional code-to-design-to-code Svelte 5 visual playground combining a live CSS hot-swap code workbench with an interactive visual canvas that computes layout geometry and exports clean markup.

name: Negentropy
description: Deterministic closed-world UI engine, Svelte AST linter, and declarative component generation pipeline for Svelte 5 and Fractalstyler that eliminates AI styling drift and CSS hallucinations.

name: Negentropy UI
description: Framework-agnostic deterministic UI compiler, 11-gate contract verification engine, and MCP-enabled prescriptive agent controller for zero-hallucination design systems across Svelte, React, and Vue.

name: Fractalpop
description: Ultra-fast, zero-dependency, DOM-free syntax highlighting engine with first-class Svelte and indented Sass grammar support that outputs deterministic HTML strings on any runtime.

name: Fractalpop Markdown
description: Zero-hydration mdsvex syntax highlighter plugin powered by Fractalpop that highlights fenced code blocks in Markdown and .svx files with automatic Svelte character escaping.

name: Fractalpop Remark
description: Unified and Remark AST plugin powered by Fractalpop that compiles fenced code blocks into syntax-highlighted HTML across Markdown and MDX pipelines including Astro, Next.js, and Docusaurus.

name: Fractalpop Svelte
description: SSR-first Svelte 5 and SvelteKit syntax highlighting components and actions for Fractalpop that render zero-hydration, flash-free highlighted code blocks.

name: Presets UI
description: Zero-dependency Svelte 5 Runes dark and light theme state engine for SvelteKit featuring FOUC prevention, cross-tab sync, OS preference detection, and animated View Transition toggles.

name: Spanda UI
description: Svelte 5 motion component library packaging 153 spring-physics interactive UI primitives—from magnetic buttons and elastic counters to gliding tabs and gesture cards—into reusable SvelteKit components.

name: Sveltekit Design
description: SvelteKit 2 and Svelte 5 AI design benchmark studio for streaming parallel UI design variations across multiple LLM providers with server-side API key security and runtime-editable prompt templates.

name: Sveltearc UI
description: Svelte 5 and SvelteKit design system ported from Arc UI combining headless Bits UI primitives, scoped CSS Modules on semantic tokens, and shared motion transitions without Tailwind.

name: Svelte Surface
description: Live design-to-code workbench and surgical AST edit engine for SvelteKit and Vite that links running DOM elements to source files for bidirectional visual editing in a native macOS or web shell.

name: Themepacks
description: Standardized TypeScript theme registry and zero-dependency OKLCH/OKLab/sRGB color math engine with WCAG contrast utilities and multi-format theme compilers for Fractal Design systems.

name: Trellis Svelte
description: Dockable, tiling, and zoomable desktop-grade workspace layout engine for Svelte 5 featuring resizable split panes, floating panels, and reference IDE, component studio, and paint applications.

name: UI Automation
description: Reference architecture and runnable playbook for deterministic LLM UI generation combining a closed-vocabulary Bits UI compiler, an 11-gate contract verifier, and the cui-lint prescriptive agent linter.

name: Unadi
description: Embeddable Elementor-style visual drag-and-drop page builder and runtime renderer for Svelte 5 and SvelteKit with host-owned persistence, HTML/CSS import, dynamic data bindings, and AI editing workflows.
